purpose: Execute the already-defined E09 critical-write idempotency and recovery claim and preserve independently recountable request, database, provider, interruption and isolation evidence. This record mirrors the active E2.0 trace matrix and does not create or expand a product contract.

implementation_basis.role: production critical-write claim, replay, completion and operation outbox kernel
production operation audit projection and transaction-context binding
production serializable PostgreSQL transaction and retry implementation
production idempotency metadata, state and operation-event contract

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently recount every operation/node request set, business number, request hash, idempotency row, business fact, audit row, operation outbox row, provider command and provider receipt; reconstruct each interruption from before/failure/retry snapshots; compare target and non-target state digests. Mutate copies to prove detection of a duplicate side effect, conflict overwrite, unclassified partial state and non-target change; do not consume runner PASS fields.

prelocked_thresholds: identical response business ID mismatch count = 0
request hash or idempotency key missing count = 0
duplicate business, provider, audit or operation Outbox side-effect count = 0
provider receipt missing or duplicate count = 0
positive_cases: Every operation on every node returns one business number from five identical concurrent requests while executing its authoritative action once.
Every fixed interruption is classified as a clean transactional rollback or a durable provider-applied/local-pending checkpoint and reaches one terminal result on retry.
Recovering Sovereign-C leaves Hosted-A and Hosted-B byte-stable under canonical state hashing.
negative_cases: The same idempotency key with a different request hash is rejected without changing the accepted result.
The oracle detects an injected duplicate business/provider/Outbox side effect.
The oracle detects an unclassified partial state and a non-target snapshot change.
unknown_rule: Missing any required artifact, operation/node scenario, request hash, idempotency key, provider receipt, audit/Outbox row, interruption snapshot, retry result or target/non-target snapshot yields UNKNOWN.

outcome_table.condition: All required artifacts and fields exist; every locked authority, conflict, interruption, provider and isolation threshold is met; every negative oracle mutation is detected.
Any complete raw observation contradicts a prelocked idempotency, recovery, provider or isolation threshold.
Any required artifact, scenario, request hash, key, database row, provider receipt, interruption snapshot, isolation snapshot or environment fact is missing or unreadable.

environment_classification: A successful disposable local PostgreSQL 17 execution with the actual production ExecutionKernel, PgUnitOfWork and local deterministic provider can establish DEV VERIFIED only.
review_classification: The criteria designer, executor and oracle operator are the same Codex task; the result remains NOT REVIEWED until a reviewer independent of the operation/recovery implementation and counting code recomputes and signs it.
